instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\user\Desktop\part1.dxf, C:\Users\user\Desktop\part2.dxf, C:\Users\user\Desktop\part3.dxf, C:\Users\user\Desktop\part4.dxf. Import part1.dxf, part2.dxf, part3.dxf, and part4.dxf. Create a nesting sheet drawing with sheet rectangle (0,0)-(260,160), part rectangles (10,10)-(90,50), (100,10)-(180,70), (10,70)-(80,140), and a closed chamfered part outline through vertices (110,90), (200,90), (220,110), (200,140), (110,140). Add text ACAD-39. Use OUTLINE for the sheet and all part geometry, and ANNOTATION for text. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. [Software] Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.
